item.description:
### Added
- Added a signed, notarized, and stapled DMG with an Applications shortcut for first-time installation without a third-party archive extractor.
### Changed
- GitHub Releases now present the DMG as the only RightMenu manual-install asset. The ZIP remains available only as the background Sparkle update archive, while the R2 mirror continues to serve that verified ZIP.
### Fixed
- Aligned the plugin deletion button with the grouped settings cards on macOS 15 while preserving its established position on macOS 26.
